response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A line with zero total cost has an undefined ratio and is excluded from the invoice average. If the overall average is zero, relative ratios are undefined and appear as missing.
